decisions.reason: A GA4 tracking plugin fits the firm's existing analytics, plugin-development, and shop-support capabilities closely, so its absorptive capacity to maintain and improve it is high and the market need in 2024 is strong.

A Google Universal Analytics plugin is technologically superseded in 2024, so despite the firm's ability to build tracking tools, its existing knowledge is now more usefully applied to GA4 and other current solutions.

A retail system interface plugin builds on the firm's interface-development and shop-integration know-how, giving it a good basis to learn from client implementations and refine the product, though its more niche positioning raises some risk.

Shop relaunch SEO support is highly complementary to the firm's established relaunch, search marketing, analytics, and conversion services, so the firm can readily absorb feedback and sell it as part of broader client projects.
